description: Reviewed text-only identities: people who are never a transcript speaker/attendee or an email/report sender anywhere in data/source/, but are named clearly enough in evidence text that a human reviewer confirmed they refer to a real person. This is NOT a roster -- structural speakers, attendees, and senders are identified automatically from the evidence itself and never need an entry here for identity purposes. A capitalized free-text span never becomes a person on its own; this file is the only path by which a text-only mention does. A verified_aliases entry may also be attached to an already-structural person purely to review a short-form alias (first name, last name, initials, nickname, or spelling variant) for that person; in that case the entry does not itself confirm identity, only the extra alias, and it is left out of the ingestion report's reviewed-text-only-identity count. Every field in every entry (canonical_name, verified_aliases, review_note, source_documents) is application-owned personal data and must be treated as purge-scannable: deleting one of these people removes that person's entire entry from this file, not just their name from other entries' text. Review notes deliberately avoid naming or quoting other people so that deleting one entry never requires editing another. Because ingestion only ever reads this file plus data/source/ -- never any other identity source, and never falls back to the untouched hackathon fixture outside data/source/ -- a normal rebuild after an entry's removal cannot resurrect the deleted person or alias.
